title: Mixed Event — Imprisoned Marionette

meta.Outline: To fulfill her promise to Mafuyu, Kanade wants to learn more about her. Meanwhile, the group visits a doll exhibit, where Mafuyu has a strange experience.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: The demo of the new song is done...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I'm tired! I look and I look and I look and I look!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
But I just can't find it...
Then when I look again, it's just not right and I get depressed...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: What am I even supposed to do?!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Even if this song isn't able to save you, I'll keep composing until I find the one that does.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I'll keep composing...until you can find yourself.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Can this song really save Yuki?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<Heeeey♪ How's everyone doing?
Those songs aren't gonna write themselves!>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Be a bit more excited! We're making a new song today!>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <I can't. I still haven't recovered from the all-nighter I pulled to finish up the drawings.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Hold on... You were up all night with me, Amia. Where are you getting all this energy from, you stamina freak?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Stamina freak?! Such a terrible thing to call someone as cute and adorable as I!>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <But it is tiring to be cute these days, so I do need a lot of stamina! I'll take it as a compliment♪>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Huh? Oh yeah, I haven't heard from her.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Sheesh, you could've spoken up sooner, don't you think?>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <I'll remember to do that next time.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <There, there! Why don't we talk about the new song? I can't wait to hear the demo♪>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Yeah. A few ideas popped into my mind while I was listening! I'm gonna try out all sorts of special effects during the chorus♪>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <How did the song make you feel?>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
<How...?
I thought it was very Kanade.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
<I don't think that's what she meant.
Was it good? Bad? Did you like it? Hate it?>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <If you like something, you'd feel that way, right?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Yuki, that's not a very nice thing to say to K, don't you think?>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <I was just answering her question honestly...>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Hey, hey! It's okay! Let's all calm down!>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
<And you too, Yuki.
Thank you for being honest with me.>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <I'm heading off for bed first. Good night.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Whoa, dropping snide remarks the moment she goes offline? Who's a scary selfie girl? Enanan, that's who!>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Hey, who are you calling a scary selfie girl...?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Isn't it cute how it rolls off the tongue so nicely?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <You're making me sound like some kind of monster.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Look, I know it's not Yuki's fault that she's acting the way she is...>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <But that doesn't mean I know how to talk to her.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <When we talked in SEKAI, she really got on my nerves, but I still think I understood her, somehow.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Now, though, doesn't she feel like an emotionless robot? Like you're talking to her but nothing ever registers.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Can either of you understand what's going on inside Yuki's head, or how she truly feels about what we're saying?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Well, the thing is... She's being a lot more honest with us than before, right?>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (Enanan is right. We still don't really understand Yuki very well.)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (I think I need to try to better understand Yuki's feelings.)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (Otherwise, there's no way I'll be able to compose a song that can save her...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: A song that will save Yuki...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (I made that bold statement out of desperation, but...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (I still don't know what kind of song would save her.)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (But I just have to compose one...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Otherwise, there's no meaning in me being here.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Today's the day Ms. Mochizuki comes over to clean.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Hello.
Today is cleaning day, yes?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Yes. Please do the kitchen today. And the bathroom.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh, by the way, I have some flavored teas with me today. Would you like to have a cup later?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Great! I'll make the tea after I finish cleaning. Once it's ready, I'll let you know.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I think I'm done brushing up the bass part.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Ms. Mochizuki should almost be done with her work too.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (Grandma really surprised me when she asked me to use a homemaker service since I was living by myself.)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (But now I think it was the right thing to do. A dirty room lowers my efficiency.)

rows.Speaker: Honami's Voice
rows.Line:
Ms. Yoisaki, I've finished cleaning!
Would you like some tea?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: It really is! This is white peach-flavored tea. Enjoy.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Really? I'm glad you like it!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Yes, because you seemed a little down today.
I'm just relieved to see you smile.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Have I told you that you're an amazing person, Ms. Mochizuki...?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: You're so good at doing housework and even show so much concern for me.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh no, I just like doing housework.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I'm really glad I took up the suggestion my mom's friend made to work as a part-time housekeeper.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Being a helper is so much fun.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Helping someone in need and making them happy makes me happy as well. Unfortunately, this sometimes makes me look a bit meddlesome...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Could I ask you for advice about something...?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh, of course. What is it?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: There's someone I'm trying to help.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: But I just don't know what to do sometimes. What would you do in a situation like that?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: First, I'd listen very closely to what that person has to say. After all, different people may want to be helped in different ways.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: What if that person doesn't understand how they want to be helped?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Then, I'd try to listen even harder.
Get to know that person more.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: You may be helping them just by understanding their feelings and the things on their mind.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: There are some people who try to carry all their burdens by themselves in order to not cause trouble to those around them.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: For people like that, just having someone there for them becomes a bright spot in their life that will give them happiness.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Get to know the person more, huh...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh, but be careful. Some people don't like being questioned too much about personal stuff.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Um... I'm sorry.
That wasn't very good advice at all.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
No, it was. Thank you, Ms. Mochizuki.
I think I'll try to get to know that person better.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I hope you can give that person the help they need.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
I hope so too. Thank you.
See you next week...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Do you happen to be interested in dolls or puppets?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Yes.
There's a doll exhibit going on nearby.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I received some complimentary tickets from a friend, but can't go because I'm busy with something else this week.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: The art gallery holding the exhibition is quite close to the hospital you visit.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I was thinking you could drop by on the way back.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: You once told me you receive inspiration from paintings for your songs, so maybe dolls could be a useful reference too...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh! That is if you want to! If you're not interested—

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Oh, no... I'll take the tickets. Thank you.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Great.
Here, and see you next week.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Yeah, yeah. By the way, K, I've completed a few design drafts, so can you take a look?>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <I have a few versions ready for you to check as well.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
(Let's take a look at Enanan's illustrations...
Yeah, they're good.)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (You can see her own interpretation of the song in them.)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (Same as always. Excellent choice of words.)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (But now, it feels a little different...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (I could understand her strong feelings from the nauseating lyrics she wrote as OWN, but now...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (I feel closer to her this way than when we're having a conversation, but her heart is always just out of reach.)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (I need to get closer to her heart...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
<Ugh, my shoulders feel so stiff now.
Hey, mind if we take a break?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <We should. K and Yuki, you okay with that?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Thanks! Speaking of stiff shoulders, it's been happening more and more recently. I wonder why?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Probably just a lack of exercise in your case? You don't even attend gym classes, right?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <I do, if I happen to be at school! That said, I'm almost never at school...>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <But I definitely exercise more than K!>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <It's true that I seldom go outside, though. All the fashion brands I'm currently into can be bought online, and I can watch all the movies and anime I want at home too...>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Though I certainly wouldn't mind going out for something fun and interesting.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Oh, in that case... Would you like a ticket for a doll exhibit?>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Yes. Someone I know passed me a couple. But I doubt I'll be going, so...>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<A doll exhibit, huh?
Like antique dolls and stuff?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Then I'd like to go! I've always wanted to make some vintage-style dresses, so this may help!>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <The doll on the ticket is wearing clothing that reminds me of you, actually.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <It looks like there's a lot of other dolls on display too, like mechanical dolls, marionettes and...>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <That's definitely gonna be super interesting! Hey, why don't we all go?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Why? Plus, I doubt K received four tickets.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Yes, I only have two tickets. Oh... But each ticket allows entry for up to two persons.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Then it's perfect♪ Fate has decreed that we must turn this into a group outing!>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <And I'm asking why we have to all go together. I'm not really interested in dolls or puppets.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Aww, come on. It's not every day that you get a chance to go hang out with K, you know?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Besides, what if they serve as inspiration for your illustrations?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <You need good artistic input to create great works, right?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Yeah, I guess. I've never paid much attention to dolls before, so it'll be something new.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <The dolls may inspire you to write some fantastic lyrics, and best of all, this outing may end up being surprisingly fun!>

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Then, I'd try to listen even harder.
Get to know that person more.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Would you like to come with us, Yuki?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <So you're coming with us! When's a good day? Yuki and Enanan have school on weekdays, so how about next Saturday?>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
<I have cram school until noon on Saturday.
Also, I need to be home by 5:00 PM.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Which means you can join us from noon until 5:00 PM?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <It is! Let's meet on Saturday at noon then♪>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (Maybe this will help me get to know Yuki better...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I'm heading for cram school now, Mom.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I have to go somewhere for a while after class ends, but I'll be back by around 5:00 PM.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: Oh? Where are you going after class?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: The art gallery. An acquaintance of mine received complimentary tickets and invited me to go along.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: How wonderful! What kind of exhibition is on right now?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Yes. There will be many different dolls on display, such as antique dolls.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: That sounds lovely... But you should really be spending your time on something more educational and emotionally enriching like paintings instead of dolls.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: You just reminded me that there's an exhibition on the paintings of Vermeer and Monet going on right now. Those are my favorites.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I see. Shall we go see the paintings together on another day, then?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: Yes, another day, since your friends asked you out so nicely today.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: Have a good time and work hard in class.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
It doesn't matter what the exhibition is about.
I won't feel anything.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <How did the song make you feel?>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Hey, Yuki... I mean.
Mafuyu. Over here.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Yes. Ena and Mizuki aren't here yet.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
I'm heeere!
You're both so early!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Mizuki, don't just run off like that so suddenly.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Nah, we just bumped into each other on the way here. I'm utterly flabbergasted that Ena didn't oversleep today...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Are you trying to say that I'm always late?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Anyway, let's go to that doll exhibit!!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Wow. This is a pretty big venue.
I thought it'd be a lot smaller.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Yeah, I'm surprised.
This place is very impressive.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Whoa...! The dolls are so cute!
Look! This one even has furry ears!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: How do you even make puff sleeves so tiny?! Hang on, this dress would look perfect on Kanade!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Pipe down, Mizuki. We don't need a running commentary on everything you see, okay?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: They're amazing... Each doll has its own world.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Yes. You can tell what sort of world they live in just by looking at them.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Mafuyu's expression changed slightly just now.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Did it? Looked the same to me.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Anyway, hurry up and let's keep going.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (Why did she have that look on her face just now?)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (I need to understand her feelings better, as well as what's on her mind.)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Why does this doll look so lifelike...? Is it its complexion?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Hm, looks like a lot of work went into the eyes too. The way they sparkle when the light hits them...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Hey, I found more by the same artist over there.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Let's go see! Oh, there's a shop here too! I'll go take a look inside later♪

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Is there anything that catches your eye, Mafuyu...?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I'm going to use the restroom.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (Oh... It's being held up by strings.)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (Hmm... Why does this doll seem so...?)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Mafuyu's taking a long time. Is she okay?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: The restroom should be that way... Huh?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Mafuyu, you're really pale!
What happened? You're not feeling well?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
You mean this marionette here?
What's wrong with it?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
There you are!
Whoa! What's going on?!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Mafuyu! You okay?!
Are you feeling sick?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Oh, good. Looks like you're better now.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Don't scare us like that.
You had us worried there.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Mafuyu, did that doll make you feel something?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Why did that doll make you feel sick?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I only know that I felt sick...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Hey, Kanade, not sure why you're bringing this up now, but maybe we should talk about it at another time since Mafuyu's not feeling too good?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (But I'm so close to understanding what could have left Mafuyu so shaken.)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Maybe you should go home first and rest a little. I'll walk you to the station, okay?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: It's fine. I can go home by myself...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (I understood nothing in the end, even though Mafuyu definitely felt something strongly back there.)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (What did she see in that doll?)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (I don't know... I just don't know right now...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I may not know, but maybe...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
I wonder where she is today.
I hope I can find her quickly.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Miku!
I'm glad I found you so quickly.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Mizuki taught me, in case I feel bored when I'm here by myself.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Well, I wanted to ask you something.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Yes. They may be the key to writing a song that will save her if I can just find out what they are.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I've been trying to talk with her about a lot of things to get to know her better, but I still don't understand.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I thought maybe you knew something since you were with her back then.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: But I don't know what Mafuyu is feeling right now either.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: This SEKAI was born from her feelings, but it doesn't mean I know what she's feeling right now...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: But we can think about it together.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I was so close to understanding something at the doll exhibit today.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Yes. When Mafuyu saw a certain doll there, she had this look of tremendous disgust on her face.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: So I think she must have felt something back then.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: What sort of doll was it?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: A beautiful doll in a dress. It was seated on a pedestal that looked like a golden cage and... Oh yeah...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I think it was a marionette.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Maybe the doll reminded Mafuyu of herself.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: It's just a feeling that I have...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (Why is it all dark? I thought I was doing some work in my room...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
(I can't move...?
Or talk, or open my eyes...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (Isn't this the doll exhibit we visited today? What am I doing here?)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Whoa, look at that, Ena!
Isn't it amazing?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Wow, it's very well done.
It almost feels alive.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (Why does it feel like they're talking about me?)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Hey, this doll has strings attached to it.
Is it a marionette or something?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Cool! I wish we could make it move around! I'm guessing it'd be pretty hard considering the size of this thing.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Don't touch it, Mizuki. It looks really expensive.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Hey, that doll over there's super cute too♪

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I told you to stop running around!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
(Is that why I can't move?
That's impossible...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (I don't mind. Being a doll, that is.)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (It means I don't have to do anything or think anymore.)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (I don't have to look for myself anymore. I just need to do as I'm told.)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (Everyone will be happier that way, right...?)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
You're feeling something right now.
Tell me what it is.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Why do you want to know?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
I can't feel anything.
How many times do I have to say it?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: And even if I did feel something, nobody would care...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Tell me what you're feeling, Mafuyu.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Yes, it's me. I thought you went to sleep.>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Oh. I logged into Nightcord and then fell asleep.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <A dream about me turning into a doll...>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <I turned into that disgusting doll we saw at the exhibit today, and I couldn't move or talk.>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <But then you appeared in front of me, and...>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <And? What was I doing in there?>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <I don't remember... I think you were trying to say something to me.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
<I see...
And how did that dream make you feel?>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Sorry, but I really want to know...>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <I want to see things from your point of view and understand your feelings, because then I'll be one step closer to writing a song that will save you.>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <Since I don't even understand myself very well.>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <I just don't understand. I live my life every day, but nothing gives me pleasure or joy.>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <Yet I can sense that something vital is missing.>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <How do I even put this into words?>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (I feel closer to her this way than when we're having a conversation.)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (If she can't put her feelings into words properly, then...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <How about you put it into lyrics?>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Lyrics are words too, but I also believe they're a little different.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <You don't have to explain yourself or try to understand them.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Just turn what you're feeling now into song lyrics.>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <Turn what I'm feeling now into song lyrics?>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <I think those lyrics will help me to get closer to you, like the time you were posting as OWN.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Why not? When you were posting as OWN...>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <That was because the messy lump inside my heart forced its way out!>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <I can't consciously turn these feelings into lyrics.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (What can I do if even Yuki doesn't understand herself?)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Maybe the doll reminded Mafuyu of herself.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (If that marionette did remind Yuki of herself, like Miku said...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <That marionette you saw at the doll exhibit made you feel sick, remember?>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <And then you had a dream about becoming one.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Could it be because you saw yourself in that marionette?>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <So, Yuki. Try to remember what you saw in that marionette, and then turn those feelings into lyrics.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Understanding your feelings may be the key I need to write a song that will save you.>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <Fine, but I don't know how this will turn out...>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: It made me feel sick because...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
But why don't I know?
Why did it make me feel that way?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: This is going to just end up like the last time...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Kanade visited a short while ago too.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yes. She wanted to understand your feelings.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: It's not like she can do anything even if she did.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I don't need something that's so unpleasant, painful and utterly useless.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Everything you feel is an important part of you. Even the things that are unpleasant and painful.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Everything... Is a part of me...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Why is there a doll here?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
It's also a marionette.
But without any strings...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: This doll has always been in your SEKAI.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Done. Look, Mafuyu...
I made a ladder.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I didn't know you could play cat's cradle.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I cut off the strings on the marionette and turned them into strings for cat's cradle.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: You can use them to tie things together, do needlework or manipulate dolls.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: And... You can also use them to make something like this.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: A marionette without strings isn't a marionette anymore.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: It also means this doll is now free.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Hm... It's already been an hour, but Yuki's not here yet. I guess she's still not feeling that great?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <I just hope she doesn't suddenly vanish again like before.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <I'm less stressed when she's not around.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <You say that, but I know you're worried about her deep down. Enanan's a huge softie under that prickly exterior.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Anyways, K, did Yuki say anything to you?>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Sorry, I forgot to mention. I'm asking Yuki to write some new lyrics based on how she felt when she saw that doll...>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Oh! So that's why she's not here.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Basically, you want her to turn the disgust she felt when she saw that marionette into song lyrics?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <I don't understand what Miku was trying to say when she suggested Mafuyu could be seeing herself in that marionette. What do you think she means?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Hm, I can sorta understand why she thought they were alike. Kinda sorta.>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: You'd be better off spending time with people who can challenge you rather than those who always need your help. That way you'd actually be learning something as well.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: Make sure you're valuing your own time.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Yuki pretty much does everything her mom says...>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <And a marionette is a puppet someone controls, right?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <So she may have thought the marionette was just like her—always under someone else's control.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <If you don't like being manipulated, just speak up.>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <K, I finished the lyrics. Can you take a look?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Because it's completely different from your usual stuff! It's not like OWN either and... It just feels so alive!>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <It's like I'm seeing a part of Yuki I've never seen before!>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Yes, it really is very different from before...>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: It's so annoying that she can write something like this too...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Yuki, may I turn this into a song?>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <I want to make music for these lyrics right now.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Me too! It'll be fun to make a music video for this! Right, Enanan?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Wow, Enanan's being compliant? You're full of surprises!>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Because if I say no, you'll go on and on about my prickly exterior and whatnot again, right?>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <I'll write a song that's perfect for these lyrics, Yuki.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <I think it's amazing! This wasn't the kind of song I was expecting to come out from those lyrics.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <It's like moody pop music and that's incredibly cute! You really outdid yourself, K!>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <But... There's a dull pain in my heart...>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <It hurts, but... It's not nearly as bad as the pain I felt before when I went to SEKAI.>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <I didn't know my lyrics could turn into a song like this.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Yuki, you said before that you can't feel or understand happiness and joy. But I have a different opinion.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <I think that you've probably convinced yourself that you just can't.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <How else would you be able to write lyrics like these?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <So maybe it's better for you to express yourself more openly!>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Try expressing your feelings in different ways, like through your lyrics this time... Maybe you could express yourself through art like Enanan too!>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Well, the best way is still to say it out loud, but some things just can't be put into words.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <So if you feel something, anything at all, just be honest and spit it all out! Think you can try doing that?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <At least when you're with us, you know...?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <That would be a lot better than awkward silence.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Enanan, couldn't you say that a little nicer?>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <The better we can understand your feelings, the closer we'll be to making a song that can save you.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <You may even find your true self in the process.>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <I don't know if I can actually do that, but I'll try...>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: If that's so... Maybe, just maybe, I'll be able to find it after all.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <The coloring makes this illustration look filthy.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Now look here! I deliberately chose that color theme because the picture's supposed to portray a messy sort of atmosphere!>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <This line here is crooked and it bothers me.>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <This expression on this person is really beautiful. I think it goes well with the song.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Huh? Oh, well... I spent the most time on that part, so... Of course?>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <But it feels off-balance on the whole.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
<What's your problem?!
Why do you keep picking on me?!>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <I'm just expressing what I feel out loud.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <You two told her to be honest with whatever's on her mind and this is what she's like now! I'm holding you responsible for everything she says from now on!>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Well, this is like rehab in a way so...>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <The effects in the MV during the chorus hurt my eyes.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Whoa, it hits hard when she dishes it out like that.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <I'm enjoying myself right now. What about you?>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <I'm still not sure... But I think I may be feeling the same way too.>
